subject: general
question: Which of the following was NOT a consequence of the Revolt of 1857?

options.text: Policies that favoured zamindars and landlords were struck down.
Lands and properties of Muslims were confiscated en masse.
The strength of Indian soldiers in the army was reduced.
The Governor-General of India was given the title 'Viceroy'.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Policies that favoured zamindars and landlords were struck down.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Policies that favoured zamindars and landlords were struck down:** This statement is incorrect. After the Revolt of 1857, the British implemented policies that favored zamindars and landlords to ensure their loyalty to the British regime. They were given land ownership rights and support to prevent any future rebellion. Hence, this statement is incorrect.
 
• **Lands and properties of Muslims were confiscated en masse:** This statement is correct. The British perceived Muslims as the primary instigators of the revolt and, as a punitive measure, confiscated their lands and properties on a large scale. This was part of a broader strategy to suppress dissent and weaken Muslim influence. Hence, this statement is correct.
